name: Therysil
summary: At the Shrine of Aessina in central Ashenvale, Therysil waits for news of her sister. A daughter of Cenarius, she guards the wild and its spirits, while Therylune remains in the hands of the Twilight's Hammer cultists.

sections.title: A Guardian's Vigil
sections.body: Therysil keeps watch beside the waters of the Shrine of Aessina, in Ashenvale's ancient woods. As a dryad and daughter of Cenarius, she is bound to defend the wild and its spirits. Now her thoughts turn to Therylune, captured nearby by the deranged Twilight's Hammer cult. Therysil waits for a wandering ally to help rescue her sister.

faq.answer: Therysil dwells at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. She is a dryad, a daughter of Cenarius, and Therylune's sister.

Therysil fears for Therylune, her sister, whom Twilight's Hammer cultists ambushed and captured at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. She waits at the shrine, hoping someone can guide Therylune safely home.
Therylune is Therysil's sister and a dryad of Ashenvale. Captured by the Twilight's Hammer, she needs an escort to escape and reunite with Therysil.
Therysil can be found at the Shrine of Aessina, a sacred natural haven beside the roadway in central Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a daughter of Cenarius, Therysil shows the close bond between the Cenarion Circle and Ashenvale's natural spirits. Her plight weighs especially heavily on visiting druids.
Dryads have long stood with the kaldorei to protect Ashenvale's sacred groves, including the Shrine of Aessina.
